label: The union of surfaces consuming the holdout's source fixtures is wider than iteration 2's two drift surfaces: advisor-validate.ts loads the regression cases (:280-284) and delegation cases (:307-313) and builds its own stratified 40-row holdout from the labeled corpus (:327, :677; loadCorpus reads labeled-prompts.jsonl at :252-255); capture-scorer-eval-baseline.mjs consumes labeled corpus + holdout + ambiguity + delegation to regenerate the committed scorer-eval-baseline.json (:36-40); python-compat-stress.vitest.ts (:30), executor-delegation.vitest.ts (:58) and scorer-eval-baseline-ratchet.vitest.ts (:75) add further consumers.

Measured harder-fixture geometry: 22 prompt rows of which 20 carry expectedSkill; the holdout takes the 20 holdout-harder rows (rows 1-20 of holdout-prompts.jsonl) while HARDER_SWEEP_CORPUS maps the full array (lane-weight-sweep.vitest.ts:153-157) and the sweep scores all 22 across 7 weight vectors (:645-660) - so holdout-harder is a by-construction subset of sweep-scored prompts, with no partition or record separating the two uses. [INFERENCE: holdout rows come from the 22-entry fixture; first holdout row matches fixture entry 1 verbatim; labeled-entry count 20 equals holdout-harder count 20.]

The union rule is enforceable as a static, bidirectional check extending in place at holdout-independent.vitest.ts: build family sets for every surface that reads a holdout source fixture, compute the overlap with the holdout families, and assert the computed overlap equals a declared map - an unrecorded new scoring surface then fails CI. The file already provides family normalization (:45-46), JSONL reading (:49-50), one training-family set (:92), per-row provenance (:100-106) and the disjointness assertion (:108-113). [INFERENCE: derived from the file's structure plus findings f-iter003-001 and f-iter003-002.]

Regime scoping: both scoring sites delete the same three live override variables (holdout-independent.vitest.ts:57-59; capture-scorer-eval-baseline.mjs:56-58); the capture's extra VITEST flag (:55) and fixed scoring instant (:60-64) are reproducibility controls, not independence controls - so the union check needs only the three deletes as its precondition, not regime equality. [INFERENCE: classification from opening both blocks.]

Cost/honesty mechanics: the union check is family-normalized set algebra over 22+40+6 fixture rows against 66 holdout rows and adds no scoring rerun; its honesty comes from bidirectional equality between observed fixture references and the declared map, which converts known overlap into enforced recording rather than a new measurement. [INFERENCE: based on the existing test's static set operations and the measured sizes.]

Boundary synthesis: the union-of-surfaces rule governs holdout independence only; the Q2 cross-path parity check is a separate contract where prompt overlap is expected (both paths must score the same prompts), so parity design must not be folded into the independence check. [INFERENCE: derived from findings f-iter003-001 through f-iter003-005 and the framing of Q2 in iteration-002.md:84.]

Two harder-fixture entries omit expectedSkill (entries beginning at :61 and :66); the holdout carries exactly 20 holdout-harder rows, equal to the labeled-entry count, so those two rows appear excluded from the holdout while still being sweep-scored. [INFERENCE from the measured counts, not from the builder source.]
